description:

https://x402-agent-pay.com/sandbox/ that takes an x402 developer from blank

facilitator expects (schema derived from the live verify code so it never
drifts), sign it with a browser wallet or paste-a-signature, run the REAL
free /verify, then a dry-run /simulate settle. No USDC ever moves in the
sandbox. Returns the live honest analytics counters (payloads built, verify
pass/fail, simulate pass, 7-day windows) and the wizard URL.
